content:
Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Wild grapes

Elders described gathering grapes together and spending time in one another’s kitchens making preserves and other foods. Vines were also used in basket weaving. The account makes shared work and the passing on of knowledge central to the fruit’s story.1

Places named in the catalogue

Shinnecock Hills; Shinnecock residential territories.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF p. 17. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
